subject: spanish
title: Lorca and Tragedy
welcome_lead: Federico Garcia Lorca's rural tragedies — Bodas de sangre, Yerma, La casa de Bernarda Alba — combine poetry, music, and fate.
meta_desc: Spanish HL Literature: Lorca, Andalusian tragedy.
final_note: Lorca canta y llora — y muere a manos del fascismo.

concepts.def: Lorca's term for inspired creative spirit.
Spanish literary generation including Lorca, Alberti, Cernuda.

walkthroughs.body_html: A bride flees with her former lover on her wedding day. The play moves from realism into symbolic forest of Moon and Death. Tragedy is poetic, inevitable.
Bernarda confines her five daughters in mourning for eight years. The repressed sexuality erupts catastrophically. Symbol of fascist Spain.
Lorca's lecture Juego y teoria del duende (1933) names the dark inspirational force of Andalusian art — flamenco, bullfighting, poetry.
